findings.detail: GUR was authored under constitution 1.2 and is revalidated under 1.4, not trusted on its declared version. 1.4 is not purely permissive over 1.2: it fixes citation cardinality at one locus per edge (DEC-2026-0008) and settles MODIFIES vs DERIVED_FROM for table lookups (DEC-2026-0011). Rows that were valid under 1.2 may fail here.

proposed node 'rule_prime_requisite' is isolated in node_changes for Reviewer approval. Prefix and kind are approved and identity checks are clear, so per DEC-2026-0003 this is not an Architect escalation.

proposed node 'rule_revivification_limit' is isolated in node_changes for Reviewer approval. Prefix and kind are approved and identity checks are clear, so per DEC-2026-0003 this is not an Architect escalation.

sys_ability_scores DERIVED_FROM rule_ability_generation is the inverse of canonical rule_ability_generation FEEDS_INTO sys_ability_scores. Under DEC-2026-0011 an input that changes a mechanic uses input MODIFIES mechanic, including direct table lookups, and the same dependency is not recorded both ways. The proposal restates an existing canonical assertion and is dropped rather than retyped.
